checkpoints.reload: Fresh-process verification for the final adapter, identical to the smoke tolerances.
checkpoints.resume: No automatic resume; preserve incomplete runs and review any recovery explicitly.
checkpoints.selected_for_comparison: Final update 91 only; validation monitoring does not select checkpoints.

compute.checkpoint_estimate: ~199 MiB adapter+two FP32 optimizer moments per checkpoint before overhead; reserve2 GiB across checkpoints, logs and probes.
compute.estimate: Plan 10-30 minutes for training plus checkpoints/validation, and 15-45 minutes for environment/model setup. Linear smoke scaling is only a lower-detail reference; no full-length GPU measurement yet.
compute.expected_memory: Same frozen base/LoRA/batch; plan 4-8 GiB PyTorch allocated for <=512 tokens and retain >=12 GiB free VRAM preflight. Smoke3.195 allocated/3.479 reserved at <=261 tokens; extrapolation is unverified.
compute.required: Free single T4, >=14 GiB physical and >=12 GiB free VRAM; >=6 GiB available host RAM; >=20 GiB free disk.

evaluation.aya_validation_usage: 66 provisionally eligible of89 candidates; all89 packaged for review, concerns excluded from loss evaluation. Group-isolated, no generation tuning or best-checkpoint selection.

generation.precision: same NF4 FP16 base for both systems

evaluation.protocol: Human rubric after one frozen base and one final-adapter generation; do not use for checkpoint selection.

initialization: Original frozen base plus new adapters; never resume the smoke adapter.

prior_proposal_review.scope: Historical agent observations only; no human or legal clearance.

review_gates: User approves exact revised subset, exploratory screening policy, and configuration before any training.
